LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Raider.title: coastal raider
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Raider.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rowed with a raiding crew every summer, striking fast at undefended coasts and gone before the alarm bells stopped ringing.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Hunter.title: snow hunter
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Hunter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] followed elk and wolves through deep snow for weeks at a time with nothing but a bow, a knife and a fur bag.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Smith.title: bog-iron smith
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Smith.description: [PAWN_nameDef] dug iron from the bogs, smelted it in clay furnaces and twisted it into the patterned blades the jarls prize.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Skald.title: skald
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Skald.description: [PAWN_nameDef] knows a thousand verses and the family tree of every jarl. [PAWN_pronoun] won more feuds with mocking poems than others did with axes.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Shipwright.title: shipwright
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Shipwright.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built longships with overlapping planks and rivets, shaping every rib by eye. [PAWN_pronoun] can build a house as easily as a hull.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Farmer.title: steading farmer
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Farmer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept goats, barley and a stubborn cow on a steading by a cold fjord. Every summer was too short and every winter too long.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Berserker.title: berserker
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Berserker.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wore a bear skin into battle and fought like the animal itself. Afterwards [PAWN_pronoun] remembered nothing, and the others did not like to talk about it.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Trader.title: amber trader
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Trader.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carried amber, furs and walrus ivory south and came back with silver and stories. [PAWN_pronoun] speaks a little of every language.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_FjordChild.title: fjord child
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_FjordChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up fishing from small boats and swimming in water so cold it stopped the breath.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_HallChild.title: mead hall child
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_HallChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the jarl's hall, carrying horns of mead to warriors and listening to their boasts late into the night.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Thrall.title: thrall's child
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_Thrall.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born unfree and worked in the fields from the day [PAWN_pronoun] could carry a basket, until a kind jarl set [PAWN_objective] free.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_ForestChild.title: forest child
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BS_ForestChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a hunter's cabin deep in the pine woods, learning tracks before letters.
